original: アスベルの剣とヴェイグの剣は\n対照的だな
traducao: Asbel's and Veigue's swords\nare complete opposites.

original: 確かにそうかもしれないな
traducao: That might indeed be true.

original: ヴェイグの剣は大ぶりで\n太刀筋も俺とは全く違う
traducao: Veigue's sword is massive, and his\nswordplay is completely unlike mine.

original: お前の「抜刀」……。\n見た事もない、独特の構えだ
traducao: Your "drawing stance"...\nIt's a unique style I've never seen.

original: オレには出来ない戦い方だろう
traducao: It's a way of fighting I couldn't do.

original: 俺はこの拳だけで戦うからな
traducao: I fight with just these fists.

original: 見栄えのする武器を使ってるのって、\nちょっと羨ましい気もするな
traducao: Using such impressive weapons,\nI feel a little envious sometimes.

original: そうか？\n……オレは拳もいいと思う
traducao: Is that so?\n...I think fists are fine, too.

original: 拳でしか、語れないものもある
traducao: Some things are only spoken with fists.

original: ヴェイグ、なかなか話がわかるじゃないか
traducao: Veigue, you get it pretty well!

original: 男は、拳を交わして\n語らう事が出来るものだ
traducao: Men can communicate\nby crossing fists with each other.

original: そうする事でしか\nわかり合えない事もある
traducao: There are things that can only\nbe understood that way.

original: そうそう！　\nそうなんだよな
traducao: Right on!\nThat's exactly it.

original: ……途中から、話が渋い方向に\nいっているのは気のせいか？
traducao: ...Is it just me, or did this take\na hardboiled turn midway through?

original: そういえば、\nティアは歌が得意なんだよな
traducao: Come to think of it, Tear,\nyou're good at singing, right?

original: 誰かに習っていたのか？
traducao: Did someone teach you?

original: そんな話、誰に聞いたの？
traducao: Who did you hear that from?

original: 別に、得意っていう程じゃ……
traducao: It's not that I'm good at it...

original: そうなのか？
traducao: Is that so?

original: でも、聞いた話じゃ\nあんまりみんなが歌えない\n特別なのも歌えるんだろ？
traducao: From what I heard, you can sing\nspecial songs that most people\naren't able to sing, right?

original: 特別……。\nそうね、そうとも言えるかしら
traducao: Special...\nYes, I suppose you could say that.

original: 私が歌うのはとても古い歌で、\n言葉や歌そのものの意味を\n正しく解釈するのが、とても難しいから
traducao: What I sing are very ancient hymns,\nand interpreting the true meaning\nof the words is quite difficult.

original: へえ。\nよくわからないけど、すごいんだな
traducao: Huh.\nI don't quite get it, but it's neat.

original: そうだ。\n機会があったら今度\n聞かせてくれないか？
traducao: Hey.\nIf there's ever a chance,\nwould you let me hear it sometime?

original: 私の歌を？
traducao: My singing?

original: 他に誰がいるんだ？
traducao: Who else would it be?

original: いえ……そんな風に\n面と向かってお願いされた事が\nないものだから……
traducao: No... It's just that no one\nhas ever asked me so directly\nto my face before...

original: でも……ありがとう
traducao: But... thank you.

original: そこ、礼を言うところなのか？\n何だか、照れくさいな……
traducao: Is that something to thank me for?\nIt kinda makes me feel embarrassed...

original: セネルは以前、\n保安官の仕事をしていたそうね。\n長く勤めていたの？
traducao: Senel, I heard you used to work\nas a sheriff in the past.\nDid you serve for a long time?

original: だ、誰からそんな話聞いたんだ？
traducao: Wh-Who did you hear that from?

original: 別に、保安官をしていたわけじゃない。\nただ、世話になってた人間が\n保安官みたいな事をしていて……
traducao: It's not like I was a sheriff.\nThe guy who looked after me just did\nwork like a sheriff, and...

original: その仕事を手伝ううち、周りが勝手に\nそんな風に茶化して言う様になっただけだ
traducao: While helping him, people just started\nteasing me by calling me that.

original: そう。\n周りが勝手に、ね……
traducao: I see.\nPeople around you, hm...?

original: 何だよ。\nその含みのある言い方は
traducao: What's that supposed to mean?\nSaying it with that loaded tone.

original: 不本意そうに説明する割には、\nちっとも表情が嫌そうじゃ\nないんだもの
traducao: For explaining it so reluctantly,\nyour expression doesn't look bothered\nby it in the slightest.

original: 素直じゃないのね、あなたも
traducao: You're not honest with yourself either.

original: あ、○○さん
ちょうどいいところに。\n今、あなたの話をしていたの
traducao: Right on time.\nWe were just talking about you.

original: 依頼達成数３００回突破、\nおめでとう！
traducao: You passed 300 quests completed!\nCongratulations!

original: おめでとう
traducao: Congratulations.

original: おめでとう！
traducao: Congratulations!

original: おめでとうございます
traducao: Congratulations to you!

original: おめでとさん
traducao: Congrats.

original: すごいね。\nもう３００回だって……
traducao: That's amazing.\n300 quests already...

original: どうりで最近、ギルドに仕事が\nたくさん来るはずだよね
traducao: No wonder so much work has been\ncoming into the guild lately!

original: そうですね。\n○○さんの活躍で\nギルドの活動が軌道に乗った感じがします
traducao: Indeed.\nThanks to ○○'s efforts, I feel\nthe guild's work has gotten on track.

original: ○○、\n頑張ってるもんな
traducao: ○○'s been working\nreally hard, after all.

original: ここには色んな依頼が来るのに、\n毎回、きちんと目を通してさ……
traducao: So many requests come here, yet\nyou look through every single one...

original: ああ。\nま、日頃の行いの積み重ねって奴か
traducao: Yeah.\nGuess that's dedication paying off.

original: そうね。\nおかげでアドリビトムの知名度も\n上がってきてるみたいだし……
traducao: True.\nThanks to that, Ad Libitum's name\nseems to be getting widely known...

original: ○○には\n感謝もしてるけど、今は\nどこまで成長してくれるかも楽しみかな
traducao: I'm grateful to ○○,\nand looking forward to seeing how\nmuch more you'll continue to grow.

original: これからも無理はしない程度に\nこの調子で、よろしくね
traducao: Keep it up without pushing too hard,\nwe're counting on you!

original: セネルの顔の模様って変わってるよなぁ。\n生まれ付きか？
traducao: Those markings on your face are\nunusual, Senel. Born with 'em?

original: そんなわけあるか！
traducao: Of course not!

original: ……これは、マリントルーパーの証だ。\nこの職に就く者はみんな、体に\nそうとわかる刻印をしているんだ
traducao: ...This is a Marine Trooper's mark.\nEveryone in this line of work bears\na brand to show what they are.

original: そうだったのか。\n身分証明書みたいなもんなんだな
traducao: Is that right?\nSo it's kinda like an ID card, huh?

original: そういう事だ
traducao: Precisely.

original: でも、そのマリンなんちゃらを知らない\nおれ達にとっちゃ、その模様も\nアザとあんまり変わらないよな！
traducao: Still, to those of us who don't know\nthat Marine whatever, those marks\ndon't look any different from bruises!

original: ……それを言うな！
traducao: ...Don't say that!

original: あれ？　\nセネルじゃないか！\nこんな所で何してるんだ？
traducao: Huh?\nIsn't that Senel!\nWhat are you doing here?

original: あー、またいつものアレね……。\n仕方ないわ、起こしてあげましょ？
traducao: Ah, his usual habit again...\nCan't be helped, should we wake him?

original: ああ、そうだな
traducao: Yeah, let's.

original: おーい、セネル！\nこんな所で寝てたら、風邪引くぞ？
traducao: Heeey, Senel!\nSleep here and you'll catch a cold!

original: うー……ん……
traducao: Mm-m-m...

original: シャーリィ……まだ眠いよ……
traducao: Shirley... I'm still sleepy...

original: シャーリィ？\n俺はスタンだよ、セネル
traducao: Shirley?\nI'm Stahn, Senel.

original: ……って、今の明らかに寝言でしょ。\nあんたもいちいちツッコまないの！
traducao: ...Hey, he's talking in his sleep!\nDon't respond to every little thing!

original: 寝言？　\nそうなのか？
traducao: Sleep talking?\nIs that so?

original: むにゃ……
traducao: *mumble*...

original: はぁ……頭痛いわ……
traducao: *sigh*... My head hurts...

original: ねえ、セネル？\nセネルは、泳ぎが得意なんだよね
traducao: Hey, Senel?\nYou're good at swimming, right?

original: まあ、そうだな。\nそうでなければ、マリントルーパーなんて\n仕事は務まらないからな
traducao: Well, yeah.\nOtherwise, I couldn't handle the job\nof a Marine Trooper, after all.

original: じゃあ、泳ぎ方を教えてもらう事は\n出来ないかな？
traducao: Then, could you maybe teach someone\nhow to swim?

original: コハクにか？
traducao: Teach you, Kohaku?

original: ううん、わたしじゃなくて\nお兄……
traducao: No, not me.\nMy brot--

original: いやぁ〜今日はいい天気だなぁ！
traducao: Man oh man, what fine weather today!

original: ほらコハク、あそこに綺麗な鳥が\n飛んでるぞぉ！？
traducao: Look Kohaku, isn't that a pretty bird\nflying right over there!?

original: ちょ、ちょっと、お兄ちゃん！？
traducao: H-Hey, big brother!?

original: ……何だったんだ？
traducao: ...What was that about?

traducao: Normal.\n
